name: linkforge
description: Self-hostable URL shortener with click analytics, a REST API, webhooks and an interactive dashboard.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w sdk && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w sdk
